Definition: from G5528; to fodder, i.e. (generally) to gorge (supply food in abundance):--feed, fill, satisfy.
BiblicalUsage: Chortazo is to be filled, to be satisfied with food, and the Gospels use it for the hungry and the blessed. Jesus says the hungry after righteousness shall be filled, the hungry now shall be filled, and the five thousand eat and are all filled with the loaves and fishes.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe being filled in these verses is always God's work, because only He can satisfy a hunger He has put in us. I hold that the filling of the five thousand is the picture of every filling since, because Christ gives and there is always more than enough.
RelatedEvents: The Sermon on the Mount; The Feeding of the Five Thousand
